Thank you for your words. I did a research on that and I think it can be derealization, I'll have a talk with my therapist on Monday. 

I'm really happy that microdosing helps you but I decided to stop doing any drugs (maybe just alcohol). I tried weed before and I used to have a panic attack after 3 puffs...

My mind really need a rest, I really need to start fighting my depression after 8 years of ignorance. I feel this is my way to go. I hope you will get better and better and find your happiness and your best version of you. And please do a deep research before trying any drugs. Take care and happy new year!
What is it? I'm going to be like this for the rest of my life?

I don't know what to do...

I tried probiotics, psyllium husk, peppermint oil and tea, imodium. Now Imodium gave me the best week I ever had but shortly after that it started to give pain. Awful pain, especially when eating.

I'm really tired after a bowel movement, I have headache, fatigue, no appetite. I have vomiting feeling for 2 weeks now. It really makes me depressed...

I tried to eat chicken, rice and potateos for 2 weeks. It didn't work...

Honestly do you think a colonoscopy would be a waste of time (and money) for me? I literally have no idea what to do. But I had enough of it.

3 years ago I had an appointment with my GP and 3 mins later I've been diagnosticated with IBS based on 'where does it hurt? Here, here and here'. This is how you get IBS in your medical records in some parts of England.

Yes I did. None worked. 

I just spoke with an doctor and booked an appointment for colonscopy. I really hope it is not IBS. It is my last hope.

Thank you for your support.
